scope: Metadata about publicly documented records that were deleted, withdrawn, redacted, withheld, restricted, classified, declassified, or superseded in connection with 9/11 historical research.
purpose: Track the documentary lifecycle and provenance of records without bypassing access controls or reproducing material that remains unlawfully inaccessible.
9_11_source_collections: 9/11 Commission Final Report and staff materials
research_method: identify authoritative record or finding aid
record legal/administrative basis when publicly available
compare archival versions where lawfully accessible
separate documented absence from evidence of deletion
interpretation_rules: A missing webpage does not prove intentional deletion
A FOIA exemption does not establish the contents of withheld material
Redaction metadata does not establish what the redacted text said
Declassification status applies only to material actually released/declassified
A secondary copy should not be treated as an authentic original without provenance
Do not infer causation from document timing or metadata alone
security_boundary: Do not bypass authentication or access controls
Do not obtain classified or restricted material through unauthorized means
Do not expose private victim/family information
Do not publish credentials or access mechanisms
Do not reconstruct protected intelligence sources or methods
status: Public-source documentary metadata schema for lawful archival and historical research.
